component.name: FTorrent
component.summary: A lightweight and fast BitTorrent client

description.p: FTorrent is a lightweight, ad-free BitTorrent client written in C++ on FLTK and libtorrent-rasterbar. No Electron, no bundled browser, no telemetry.

ul.li: Add a .torrent file, a folder or a magnet link — or drop them onto the list window
Pause and resume per torrent, remove with confirmation
Sortable list with name, size, progress, status, down speed, up speed, ETA, ratio and peers
One-click 50 % rate limit for the session and ECO/NORMAL/TURBO RAM usage modes
Search torrents across Nyaa.si, The Pirate Bay, BTDig, SolidTorrents and BitSearch, with mirror fallbacks
Dark and light themes, a censorship toggle for screenshots, and a status bar with torrent counts, RAM and latency
